outreach_drafts.subject: Maria, here’s what we’ve been doing for Miami
outreach_drafts.body:
Dear Maria,

Thank you for giving through Give Miami Day in 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. We’re grateful for your steady commitment to Miami.

Here’s what we’ve been doing: The Miami Foundation hosted two in-person SET Summits in Wynwood and Homestead to prepare nonprofits for Give Miami Day.

We also partnered with McDermott Will & Schulte to provide free legal counsel to 17 Miami nonprofits, delivering 398 hours of service valued at more than $500,000. And we committed $100,000 to support Spanish-language coverage through elTOQUE and City of Miami coverage through The Florida Trib in partnership with the Coconut Grove Spotlight.

From nonprofit preparation to legal counsel and local reporting, these are a few ways we’re showing up for our community. Everyone has a role to play.

Will you make a Give Miami Day gift at givemiamiday.org when early giving opens Saturday, November 14, 2026?

Thank you for being part of Miami’s giving community.

Warmly,
The Miami Foundation’s Philanthropy Team

outreach_drafts.subject: Biscayne Harbor Family Foundation: a year-end conversation
outreach_drafts.body:
Dear Biscayne Harbor Family Foundation,

Thank you for your partnership and support of The Miami Foundation.

First, a local milestone worth sharing: during Florida's 2021 legislative session, Senator Ileana Garcia and State Representative Nick Duran led a successful bipartisan effort to create the Biscayne Bay specialty license plate, with plate-sale revenue designated to preserve and restore Biscayne Bay.

Here’s what we’ve done recently: we partnered with McDermott Will & Schulte to provide free legal counsel to 17 Miami nonprofits, delivering 398 hours of service valued at more than $500,000. We also committed $100,000 to support Spanish-language coverage through elTOQUE and City of Miami coverage through The Florida Trib in partnership with the Coconut Grove Spotlight.

With Give Miami Day approaching, would you join our philanthropy team for a call or coffee about your year-end giving? We’d welcome a conversation about what matters most to you.

Everyone has a role to play. Thank you for yours.

Warmly,
The Miami Foundation’s Philanthropy Team
